detection_policy: Independent multiscale luminous-core proposals on the exact baseline LRF frames. Preserve old candidates and edge/identity exclusions. Every proposed addition must be explicitly image-reviewed before position use; no predicted coordinates or time interpolation.
image_basis: 720x1280 displayed portrait LRF, metadata rotation 90 degrees; corrected LRF intrinsics and optical-to-IMU rotation
prior_sigma_status: Assumed comparison weights, not measured uncertainty
mapping_policy: Same full child images, fixed corrected main-video intrinsics, SIFT matches and seed for old/new fallback priors. Coincident camera/position centers retain pool convention; no surveyed lever arms or independent ground truth. Static trial 002 is not used to claim metric scale.
scope: Exploratory dense follow-up on the late wall-visible interval after the sparse full-trial attempt returned no map. Same images and mask for old/new fallback positions. Selection is not held-out. No existing maps overwritten.
